item.title: Choose a plant for a new flat
item.context_text: You want a plant for a shelf away from the window. Your flatmate likes flowers.
item.objective_text: Choose a plant for the shelf and explain how to look after it.
success_conditions: Choose a plant for the shelf and explain how to look after it.

children.title: Read the plant labels
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Daisy: Needs sun. Water three times a week. Ivy: Grows in shade. Water once a week. Both pots cost five pounds.

questions.prompt: Which plant can grow away from the window?
How many times a week does the daisy need water?
questions.explanation: The daisy label says three times a week.

children.title: Hear the shop assistant’s advice
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Some people put the ivy in a bigger pot. You can keep it in this small pot for one month. Put a plate under it to keep water off the shelf.

questions.prompt: What can go under the ivy pot?
questions.explanation: The assistant says to use a plate.

questions.prompt: How long can you keep the small pot?
questions.explanation: The assistant says the current pot is fine for a month.

children.title: Ask one care question
children.prompt_text: You have chosen your plant but want to double-check the watering rule.
children.instructions: Name the plant and where it will go. Ask the assistant how often it needs water.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: I would like the ivy for a shelf away from the window. How often should I water it? Is once a week enough?

children.title: Leave a care note
children.prompt_text: Your flatmate will be at home while you are away.
children.instructions: Say why you chose the plant and how often to water it. Add how to protect the shelf.
children.goal: Choose a plant for the shelf and explain how to look after it.
children.model_answer: I bought an ivy for the shelf. It likes shade, so it does not need to be by the window. Water it once a week. Please leave the plate under the pot to keep the shelf dry.
